production.note: US model years 2015 to 2016. First: the PCNA spec sheet is headed "2015 Porsche Boxster GTS and Cayman GTS". Last: kbb-2016-cayman lists a 2016 "Cayman GTS: 340 hp"; the successor generation is "the 2017 718 Cayman" (pcna-2017-718-cayman-us-press: "With the 2017 718 Cayman, Porsche is introducing the third generation of the mid-engine sports coupe"). stuttcars-cayman-gts-981 dates the car 2014-2016, the European launch year.

body.note: The open GTS is sold under its own name (Boxster GTS).

displacementL.note: Porsche states "3.4 liter" and gives no cc figure; the 3,436 cc figure is from openers-cayman-gts ("3,436 cc Horizontally Opposed 6-Cylinder Direct Injection DOHC").

aspiration.note: Inferred: the spec sheet describes a water-cooled boxer six with no turbocharger or supercharger.

fuel.note: Inferred from the spec sheet's description of the boxer six; no hybrid system.

transmission.note: "Number of gears 6-speed Manual (7-speed PDK)". DCT is Porsche PDK.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Maxmimum power output @ engine speed 330 hp @ 6,700 rpm 340 hp @ 7,400 rpm" (Boxster GTS | Cayman GTS; Porsche's spelling). Still 340 hp for 2016 per kbb-2016-cayman.

weightLb.note: Coupe with the 6-speed manual, minimum (standard-equipment) figure. Quote: "Curb weight (PDK) (lbs) min / max 2965 / 3097 (3031 / 3164) 2965 / 3109 (3031 / 3175)" (Boxster GTS | Cayman GTS). Cayman GTS: manual 2,965 lb minimum / 3,109 lb maximum; PDK 3,031 / 3,175 lb.
